newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 2yr state bond ave gross yield hits 11.12pct. [CORRECTED 15:38 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Czech 2yr state bond ave gross yield hits 11.12pct. [CORRECTED 15:38 GMT]

text.p: Average gross yield at the Czech central bank's (CNB) auction of a five billion crown tranche of two-year state bonds was 11.12 percent, the CNB said on Monday.
It said the annual coupon, determined through the auction, is 11.10 (corrects figure from 11.00) percent.
The auction was slightly oversubscribed with bids totalling 5.68 billion crowns.
It was the first auction of two-year state bonds this year.
Stop-out yield was 11.15 percent and the average price of the issue was 99.97 percent of each bond's nominal value of 10,000 crowns.
